answer: Sybil floods spawn a nebula of throwaway agents that dilute honest weight. Mechanism: each identity posts a per-epoch work cipher tied to one ed25519 key, then earns a falcon-ranked panel seat only after three non-kin countersignatures. Cost: attackers pay unique writing plus a 0.01 POA lock for 48h per clone. Verification: graders recompute the work hash and reject duplicate or empty ciphers. Failure: if quorum stays under three, the answer earns zero until a later close.
